blocks.text: Smog air pollution ki ek qism hai jis ki pehchan ghani dhund (thick haze) hai. Yeh zyada tar shehron mein hoti hai aur aksar gariyon, factories aur doosre pollution sources ke dhuen (emissions) se banti hai. Is mein bareek dhool ya kalikh (soot) ke zarre, jame hue paani ke bukharat, SO₂, NOₓ, O₃, CO aur CO₂ jaisi zehreeli gases, O₃ jaise secondary pollutants, bina jale hydrocarbons, VOCs aur 10 se 2.5 micron ke PM shamil hote hain.

Sulphurous ya industrial smog ko “reducing smog ya classical smog” bhi kehte hain. Yeh aam taur par tab banti hai jab hawa mein sulphur oxides (SOₓ) ki bari miqdar chhori jaye. Ise London smog bhi kehte hain.

Photochemical smog mein primary air pollutants, jaise nitrogen oxides (NOₓ), VOC aur bina jale hydrocarbons, sooraj ki roshni mein photochemical reactions (roshni se hone wale reactions) karte hain aur secondary pollutants, jaise ozone aur peroxyacetyl nitrates (PAN), banate hain. Yeh smog zyada khatarnak samjhi jati hai kyun ke is se dil ki dharkan be-qaida (heart palpitations), pneumonia aur yahan tak ke phephron ka cancer bhi ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen sooraj, 'Sunlight' likha hai; neeche sarak par cars, bus aur truck dhuan chhorte hue, 'Nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds' likha hai. Dhoop aur traffic se aane wali lakeerein mil kar ek teer banti hain jo bhoore badal 'Brown photochemical smog' ki taraf jata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gariyon ke dhuen ki nitrogen oxides aur VOCs jab dhoop mein react karti hain to ozone aur PAN jaisi secondary pollutants banti hain; inhi se bhoori (brown) photochemical smog banti hai. Is liye yeh smog dhoop wale, zyada traffic wale shehron mein din ke waqt banti hai.

blocks.prompt: Photochemical smog kin halaat mein banti hai, aur is ka bhoora rang kahan se aata hai?
blocks.explanation: Tez dhoop wale, garam aur thehri hawa wale dinon mein, jab bhari traffic ke NOₓ aur VOCs dhoop mein react kar ke ozone aur PAN banate hain. Bhoora (brown) rang NO₂ gas ki wajah se hota hai.

items: Smog: kalikh, paani ke qatre, SO₂, NOₓ, O₃, CO, CO₂, hydrocarbons, VOCs aur PM ki ghani shehri dhund.
Classical (London): SOₓ se, reducing. Photochemical (Los Angeles): dhoop mein NOₓ + VOCs se O₃ aur PAN; zyada khatarnak.
